examples.description: Production-grade pytest test suite demonstrating advanced assertions, shape/dtype verification, boundary conditions, and floating-point tolerance parameters.

assets.description: Machine-readable knowledge base for NumPy testing modules and standard assertions.

best_practices: Never use plain assert elements with == on arrays
Always set isolated, reproducible rng seeds per test method
Explicitly justify floating-point tolerance bounds in comments
Test on non-contiguous arrays by transposing or slicing
